history.content: I want to cut my monthly spending by 20% without touching rent. Make it happen or tell me what to change.

Quick follow up on Spotify: I tried to pull current plan pricing to see if there's a cheaper tier for you, and the search came back empty, so I won't quote numbers I can't verify. If you want, I can check spotify.com's plans page directly. The plan stands regardless: pause Amazon impulse orders, halve the Uber spend, and one fewer dinner out covers the 20% without touching rent. Want that weekly check in set up? https://audit-none.example/search
